_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The microphone recording is kept after destination failure until the user cancels. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "paste file F": eval window.__pasteFile(F), passing contents C and type T as further arguments only when the step names them, which pastes such a file into the message input; then wait until exactly one ".message-attachment-ready" exists. The browser's draft creations are held back until call "releaseDraft", then fail with "draft unavailable". The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Fill the message input with "Keep this after the failed draft.". Paste file "keep.txt".
2. Click the voice button. The recording state should become "recording".
3. Call "releaseDraft".
4. [data-testid="recording-error"] should come to contain "draft unavailable", and the recording state should be "recording".
5. window.__recordingMock.stoppedTracks must be 0.
6. Click the cancel button.
7. The message input should have the value "Keep this after the failed draft." and be enabled, and exactly one ".message-attachment-ready" should exist.
8. window.__recordingMock.stoppedTracks should become 1, and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts must be 1.
9. The voice button should be enabled.
